Sources: [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/snorkel-ai-raises-350m-to-scale-the-data-factory-for-frontier-ai-302886796.html) · [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/22/snorkel-ai-triples-valuation-to-3-5b-as-demand-for-ai-training-data-booms/).
- **2026-09-22 — CLOSEDQUORUM malware:** Cisco Talos detailed a Go Windows implant that queries up to four commercial LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Gemini), plurality-votes next actions (steal/inject/persist), and exfils via Discord; public sample ships with dummy keys—no confirmed in-the-wild campaign. Sources: [Talos](https://blog.talosintelligence.com/the-closed-quorum-inside-the-first-reported-autonomous-ai-c2-implant/) · [CAIRN repo](https://github.com/Cisco-Talos/Cognitive-Artifact-Intelligence-Research-Network).
- **2026-09-21 — Meta Muse early traction:** Apptopia estimates Muse beat ChatGPT’s first-12-day U.S./Canada iOS downloads (1.8M vs 1.3M) and showed higher early U.S. DAUs; Meta had not published official figures. Sources: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/21/metas-muse-is-outpacing-chatgpts-early-mobile-launch/).

# AI 科技简报 — 2026-09-23
**统计时段:** 2026-09-21T05:48:50Z–2026-09-23T06:01:39Z
**北京时间:** 2026-09-21 13:48–2026-09-23 14:01
**生成时间:** 2026-09-23T06:01:39Z

## 今日看点
- 9 月 22 日 Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5：公司称多数工作接近 Fable 5.1，典型成本比 Opus 5 低约 40%，并带上 Fable 级生安/网络安全限制。
- 同一天 OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna，API 价格较 GPT-5.6 对应档位降一半，并加强长程 Agent 的默认提示缓存。
- xAI 的 Grok 4.7 于 9 月 21 日上线，定价与 4.6 相同，并开始接入 GitHub Copilot。
- Snorkel AI 完成 3.5 亿美元估值 35 亿美元的 E 轮，继续押注“专家数据 + RL 环境”供给。
- Cisco Talos 开源 CAIRN，并披露 CLOSEDQUORUM：据称是首个公开的、由多家商业大模型投票决定下一步的 Windows 远控样本。

## 1. 模型发布与更新
